candidate.mistake_reason: At step 5, the Orchestrator directed the team to use the World Bank indicator NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS (“Gross domestic savings (% of GDP)”) by specifying the link https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS, even though the task asked for “gross savings (% of GDP)” (indicator NY.GNS.ICTR.ZS). This substituted a different metric than requested, leading the workflow to download (steps 8, 12) and analyze (steps 55, 59, 63) the wrong dataset.
candidate.first_mistake: This is the first concrete decision that set the project on the incorrect path. Prior steps only searched broadly (step 4), where the correct “Gross savings (% of GDP)” link also appeared, but step 5 explicitly chose the “Gross domestic savings” link, committing to the wrong indicator.
candidate.mistake_not_corrected: No later agent corrected the indicator choice. WebSurfer downloaded the dataset from the domestic-savings page (steps 8, 12), the unzipped files confirm the NY.GDS.TOTL.ZS indicator (step 55), and the Assistant analyzed that file (step 59), producing a final list (step 63) that the Orchestrator presented as the answer. Although further issues (e.g., not filtering out aggregates, name formatting) occurred later, the initial wrong indicator was never fixed and directly caused the final incorrect outcome.
